The fastest way to break a panic attack. - Yang Mun

#panic #usahealth #wellness #chinesemedicineworks #healthybodyhealthymind
transcript: The fastest way to break a panic attack. My friend, when the mind begins to spin and the body feels like it's losing control, you must speak to the nervous system first. Cold is one of the quickest messengers. If you can, fill a small bag with ice. Place it on the back of your neck or rest it on the lower part of your back. If there is no ice nearby, step into a cold shower for a moment. If even that is not possible, use cold water from a sink, submerge your face, or place the cold on your back, your chest, your arms. If you are driving, pull over safely, go into a gas station or convenience store. Fill a large cup with ice and place one or both hands deep into the cold. All of these create the same effect. They gently shock the nervous system, bringing you out of the spiral and back into the present moment. Your body remembers, I am here, I am safe. This is how the panic loosens its grip. If you or someone you love struggles with panic attacks, keep this in your toolbox. It is simple, it is safe, and it is effective. If you want to go deeper into healing and calming the nervous system, you will find my e-books and the 30-day healing journey in the link on my profile. Walk gently today, my friend.
